script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/file/download-trajectory/$CID" --expect 200 \
  --raw-out "$F/scoped-traj.zip" --save F14.scoped-trajectory-archive/trajectory
python3 -m zipfile -t "$F/scoped-traj.zip" > /dev/null
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/file/download-trajectory/$CID2" --expect 422 \
  --check detail eq 'Trajectory must belong to the selected conversation'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/file/download-trajectory/qa-f14-not-a-uuid" --expect 422 \
  --check detail eq 'Invalid trajectory conversation id'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/file/archive" --query path="$WS" --expect 200 \
  --raw-out "$F/ws.patch" --save F14.scoped-trajectory-archive/git-delta
grep -q '^diff --git a/qa-f14-agent.txt b/qa-f14-agent.txt' "$F/ws.patch"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/file/archive" --query path="$WS" --query format=tar.gz --expect 200 --raw-out "$F/ws.tgz"
tar tzf "$F/ws.tgz" > "$F/ws.list"
grep -qx "$(basename "$WS")/qa-f14-agent.txt" "$F/ws.list"
grep -qx "$(basename "$WS")/qa-f14-up/blob.bin" "$F/ws.list"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/file/archive" --query path="$REPO" --expect 422 \
  --check detail eq 'path must be inside the conversation workspace'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/file/archive" --query path="$WS" --query format=tar.gz --expect 422
